description: This file contains utility functions for mathematical operations, bit manipulations, and bitmask calculations, primarily used within the LLVM project. It includes functions for counting trailing and leading zeros, bit reversal, bit masking, power-of-two calculations, and bitwise type conversions.

classes.name: TrailingZerosCounter
classes.description: Template struct for counting trailing zeros in integers of different sizes, optimized for compiler built-ins and platform-specific intrinsics.

classes.name: LeadingZerosCounter
classes.description: Template struct for counting leading zeros in integers of different sizes, optimized for compiler built-ins and platform-specific intrinsics.

classes.name: PopulationCounter
classes.description: Template struct for counting the number of set bits (population count) in integers of different sizes, optimized for compiler built-ins.

methods.name: countTrailingZeros
methods.description: Counts the number of trailing zeros in an unsigned integer, with behavior specified for zero input.

methods.name: countLeadingZeros
methods.description: Counts the number of leading zeros in an unsigned integer, with behavior specified for zero input.

methods.name: findFirstSet
methods.description: Finds the index of the first set bit from the least significant bit, with behavior for zero input.

methods.name: findLastSet
methods.description: Finds the index of the last set bit from the least significant bit, with behavior for zero input.

methods.name: reverseBits
methods.description: Reverses the bits in a given integer value.

methods.name: BitsToDouble
methods.description: Converts a 64-bit integer to a double by interpreting the bits.

methods.name: BitsToFloat
methods.description: Converts a 32-bit integer to a float by interpreting the bits.

methods.name: DoubleToBits
methods.description: Converts a double to its bitwise 64-bit integer representation.

methods.name: FloatToBits
methods.description: Converts a float to its bitwise 32-bit integer representation.

methods.name: alignAddr
methods.description: Aligns a given address to the specified power-of-two boundary.

methods.name: alignmentAdjustment
methods.description: Calculates the adjustment needed to align a pointer to a specified boundary.

methods.name: NextPowerOf2
methods.description: Calculates the next power of two greater than a given value.

methods.name: PowerOf2Floor
methods.description: Calculates the greatest power of two less than or equal to a given value.

methods.name: PowerOf2Ceil
methods.description: Calculates the smallest power of two greater than or equal to a given value.

methods.name: alignTo
methods.description: Calculates the smallest multiple of a specified alignment greater than or equal to a value.

methods.name: alignDown
methods.description: Calculates the largest multiple of a specified alignment less than or equal to a value.

methods.name: divideCeil
methods.description: Performs ceiling division of two integers.

methods.name: SignExtend32
methods.description: Sign-extends a 32-bit integer from a specified bit width.

methods.name: SignExtend64
methods.description: Sign-extends a 64-bit integer from a specified bit width.

methods.name: AbsoluteDifference
methods.description: Calculates the absolute difference between two unsigned integers.

methods.name: SaturatingAdd
methods.description: Adds two unsigned integers with saturation at the maximum value.

methods.name: SaturatingMultiply
methods.description: Multiplies two unsigned integers with saturation at the maximum value.

methods.name: SaturatingMultiplyAdd
methods.description: Multiplies two unsigned integers, adds a third, with saturation.
